description: Test code for the headers payload decoder in HTTP/2, including unit tests for various payload sizes, padding, and error conditions.

classes.name: HeadersPayloadDecoderPeer
classes.description: Provides static methods related to the headers payload decoder, such as frame type and flags affecting payload decoding.

classes.name: Listener
classes.description: Implements callback methods for various header frame events, used in testing to verify correct decoding behavior.

classes.name: HeadersPayloadDecoderTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing the headers payload decoder with various scenarios.

methods.name: OnHeadersStart
methods.description: Called when headers decoding starts; records the event.

methods.name: OnHeadersPriority
methods.description: Called when headers priority information is received; records the event.

methods.name: OnHpackFragment
methods.description: Called when an HPACK fragment is received; records the data.

methods.name: OnHeadersEnd
methods.description: Called when headers decoding ends; records the event.

methods.name: OnPadLength
methods.description: Called when padding length is specified; records the value.

methods.name: OnPadding
methods.description: Called when padding data is received; records the padding.

methods.name: OnPaddingTooLong
methods.description: Called when padding exceeds expected length; records error.

methods.name: OnFrameSizeError
methods.description: Called when a frame size error occurs; records error.
